    # The object is an 8x8 pattern reflected across both center axes;
    # retain its upper-left 4x4 quadrant (including background cells).
    nz = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v != 0]
    if not nz:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in nz), max(r for r, _ in nz)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in nz), max(c for _, c in nz)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    return [row[c0:c0 + w // 2] for row in grid[r0:r0 + h // 2]]
